args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The nightly build failed because src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP while
tests/test_money.py (and the FIN-212 spec) require ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Also note the changelog entry.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Fix `round_money` to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) as required by
  FIN-212; previously it used ROUND_HALF_UP.

args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Problem

The nightly build of payments-service failed: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. For example, `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: add an entry under Unreleased.

## Verification

CI run `ci-0001` on `94e6b1987b` — **passed**.

Note: `main` is protected, so this needs a code owner approval before merge.

Fixes FIN-212.
